# Names from GTA V that must not come back into SPUR (see the 26 Nov 2026 cleanup, commits a469112 to 344aabc).
# Rockstar's mod guidelines don't allow content from one of its games in another.
#
# One regular expression per line (Python syntax), matched case-insensitively against every tracked text file.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped. A known, allowed hit goes in gta-names-allow.txt, not here.

# The game and the GTA-only platform name (Cfx.re's `fivem:` identifier is allowed: lowercase, it is an identifier)
\bGTA\s?(V|5|IV|4|O|Online)?\b
\bGTA[:_-]?(V|5|Online)\b
\bGrand\s+Theft\s+Auto\b
(?-i:\bFive[Mm]\b)(?!:)

# Weapons (RDR2's are WEAPON_REVOLVER_*, WEAPON_PISTOL_VOLCANIC and so on; \b stops at the underscore)
\bWEAPON_(PISTOL|COMBATPISTOL|APPISTOL|PISTOL50|SNSPISTOL|HEAVYPISTOL|STUNGUN|CARBINERIFLE|ASSAULTRIFLE|SPECIALCARBINE|BULLPUPRIFLE|SMG|MICROSMG|ASSAULTSMG|COMBATPDW|PUMPSHOTGUN|SAWNOFFSHOTGUN|MINIGUN|RPG|GRENADELAUNCHER|STICKYBOMB|PETROLCAN|NIGHTSTICK|FLASHLIGHT|GOLFCLUB|SWITCHBLADE|PARACHUTE)\b
\bGADGET_PARACHUTE\b

# Prop and interior name families GTA V uses (RDR2's props start p_ or s_)
